text.description_html:
Fusion RH-A3, Bronze River Rock Arched Robe Hook

The Bronze River Rock Arched Mount Robe Hook is available in either medium bronze or dark bronze; both finishes really build on the richness that one expects from something named river rock. It is easy to install with the included hardware. Please don't think of this beautiful hook is a one trick pony. The scalloped hook is great for hanging bathrobes as well as coats, towels, purses, hats and a whole slue of other things. So hang one by the front door, in the closet, and even put one in the pantry for your apron.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-A3 Arched Towel Bar, Fusion TR-A3 Arched Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-A3 Arched Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Bronze Scalloped Wall Mounted Rope Hook:

  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
